body.glw-rain #glWeatherLayer::before,body.glw-thunder #glWeatherLayer::before{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(116deg,transparent 0 14px,rgba(184,219,236,.34) 15px 16px,transparent 17px 31px);background-size:44px 88px;animation:glwRain .72s linear infinite;filter:blur(.15px)}
body.glw-snow #glWeatherLayer::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(245,251,255,.75) 0 1.2px,transparent 1.7px),radial-gradient(circle,rgba(232,244,250,.55) 0 1px,transparent 1.5px);background-size:42px 58px,67px 79px;background-position:0 0,23px 18px;animation:glwSnow 7s linear infinite}
